result.instructions: Tools for MapTiler, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MapTiler data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run maptiler_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run maptiler_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run maptiler_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. maptiler_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: maptiler_geocode
tools.title: Forward geocode (search place by name)
tools.description: Search for a place, address, or POI by name and get matching locations as GeoJSON features. e.g. 'Zurich' or '1600 Pennsylvania Ave'. API: GET /geocoding/{query}.json.

query.description: Place/address/POI to search for (goes in the URL path).

proximity.description: Bias toward a point: "lon,lat" or the literal "ip".

language.description: Comma-separated ISO 639-1 language codes for results.

country.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to restrict to.

types.description: Comma-separated place types to include (e.g. address,poi,city).

excludeTypes.description: If true, `types` becomes an exclude list instead.

fuzzyMatch.description: Allow approximate matching of the query terms.

autocomplete.description: Treat the last term as a prefix for as-you-type search.

worldview.description: Disputed-border worldview: default | auto | ch | us.

tools.name: maptiler_reverse_geocode
tools.title: Reverse geocode (place at coordinates)
tools.description: Find the place(s) at a given longitude/latitude, returned as GeoJSON features. API: GET /geocoding/{longitude},{latitude}.json.

language.description: Comma-separated ISO 639-1 language codes for results.

excludeTypes.description: If true, `types` becomes an exclude list instead.

worldview.description: Disputed-border worldview: default | auto | ch | us.

tools.name: maptiler_batch_geocode
tools.title: Batch forward geocode
tools.description: Forward-geocode up to 50 queries in one request. Returns a JSON ARRAY of GeoJSON FeatureCollections, one per query, in order. API: GET /geocoding/{q1;q2;...}.json.

language.description: Comma-separated ISO 639-1 language codes for results.

country.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to restrict to.

autocomplete.description: Treat the last term of each query as a prefix.

worldview.description: Disputed-border worldview: default | auto | ch | us.

tools.name: maptiler_geolocate_ip
tools.title: Geolocate IP address
tools.description: Geolocates the IP address making the request — from a hosted Worker this is the server's egress IP, not the end-user's. API: GET /geolocation/ip.json.

elevation.description: Include elevation of the located point.

tools.name: maptiler_get_elevation
tools.title: Get elevation at coordinates
tools.description: Look up ground elevation at up to 50 coordinates. Returns an array of [lng, lat, elevation] triples. API: GET /elevation/{locations}.json.

tools.name: maptiler_transform_coordinates
tools.title: Transform coordinates between CRS
tools.description: Transform up to 50 coordinate pairs from a source coordinate reference system to a target one (EPSG codes). API: GET /coordinates/transform/{coordinates}.json.

coordinates.description: 1-50 [x, y] coordinate pairs in the source CRS.

ops.description: Pipe-separated transformation operation codes to force a path.

tools.name: maptiler_search_coordinate_systems
tools.title: Search coordinate reference systems
tools.description: Search MapTiler's CRS/EPSG database by free text or key:value filters (e.g. 'code:4326', 'kind:CRS-PROJCRS'). API: GET /coordinates/search/{query}.json.

query.description: Search terms; supports filters like "code:4326" or "kind:CRS-PROJCRS".

transformations.description: Include available transformations for each CRS.

exports.description: Include WKT / Proj4 export strings for each CRS.

tools.name: maptiler_get_data_features
tools.title: Get dataset features (GeoJSON)
tools.description: Fetch the GeoJSON FeatureCollection of a MapTiler-hosted dataset by its data id. API: GET /data/{dataId}/features.json.

dataId.description: MapTiler dataset id (from your MapTiler Cloud account).
